newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Philips shares rebound after early fall.
newsitem.headline: Philips shares rebound after early fall.

text.p: Shares in Philips Electronics NV recouped earlier heavy losses on Thursday to stand one guilder higher at 57.60 by 0917 GMT.

The shares plunged at the start of trading, falling to a low of 53.00 guilders after it announced lower-than-expected third quarter profits of 123 million guilders against 539 million in the same 1995 period. It also warned of a huge one billion guilder charge in the fourth quarter.
"The shares are off their lows. That, I think, is massive short-covering," one dealer said.
